scope: Unique shared inputs proposed for one complete QT-GHI mother draft; Lead adoption remains explicit.

experiments.waiting_times: Adjacent observed interior events only; left/right window waiting segments are censored.
experiments.model_count_interval: N(a,b] is a separate mathematical convention.

rng.draw_order: Exactly as the existing source algorithm; no preceding draws.

gbm_P_illustration.identity: Teaching physical model; not fitted to observed returns.

aapl_optional_context.identity: Retrospective daily adjusted description, not intraday QV or historical execution.

contract.underlying_identity: Hypothetical tradable GBM asset; not XSP index shares.

path_recipe.pair_by: Identical path index within the shared normal array.
path_recipe.meaning: Common random numbers and deterministic time scaling, not a change-of-measure theorem.

experiments.holding_rule: After observation/fill at t_k, q_k=100*Phi(d1) serves (t_k,t_(k+1)]; at T, q_n=0.
event_order: At inception receive model premium with q=0.
For k>0 accrue previous cash at exp(r*dt).
Observe S_k and compute target using time-k information.
Trade dq at model mid plus/minus half-spread.
At T flatten all shares, including closing spread.
Pay model cash payoff at the same T.
model_assumptions: half-spread is an assumed one-way cost, not an observed quote
experiments.error_definition: Cash after terminal hedge liquidation minus call payoff; dollars, not a return rate.

short_hand_path.identity: Chosen hand path, distinct from simulated first path.

distribution_data_to_export_after_adopti.currently_available: Per-design summary moments/quantiles and first-path CSV only.
distribution_data_to_export_after_adopti.needed: Twelve same-index path-error arrays, or fixed histogram bins with exact edges, closure, counts and totals; preserve pairing if recomputing paired MSE.
distribution_data_to_export_after_adopti.validation: Derived summaries must agree with existing candidate output; no new browser RNG.
distribution_data_to_export_after_adopti.agent_pack: Include current design and representative complete ledger once; provide public readable/recomputable attachments for full arrays, not twelve repeated inline enumerations.

real_rule_context.unit: Underlying, Multiplier, Exercise Style, Settlement of Option Exercise
real_rule_context.distinction: XSP is SPX/10 with $100 multiplier and European cash exercise; cash delivery next business day. No actual historical quote or broker booking-time claim.

P26_coordination.scope: P26 reuses the existing hand-path ledger and inputs; rule/funding decisions remain P26, computation owner QT24.

QT25_scope.A: KMZ published §V.A–C; three separate preprocessing layers, footnotes33–35/38–40; Nagel optional.
QT25_scope.B: HTZ fixed arXiv v1 §2, §3.1–3.5, §4.1–4.3, introduction/conclusion; model setting read, no functional-Ito proof or training replication claimed.

adoption_scope: All four named experiments, exact defaults and shared identities in the independent recommendation; dataset export remains a required author deliverable.
